note: Commerce Add To Cart Link renders an add-to-cart LINK (GET /add-to-cart/{product}/{variation}/{token}) instead of the Commerce form. Its display mechanism is an 'add_to_cart_link' pseudo/extra field added by hook_entity_extra_field_info() to every commerce_product and commerce_product_variation view display (hidden by default) - shown by adding the component to the entity_view_display config. Its settings config object is commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings with keys csrf_token.roles (sequence of role ids whose links get a CSRF token via the commerce_add_to_cart_link.token service) and redirect_back (bool). It also provides a @ViewsField('commerce_add_to_cart_link') and a themeable Twig template. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real live config: introspection reads csrf_token.roles/redirect_back and which view display shows the pseudo field; execution shows the pseudo field on commerce_product.default.default and sets csrf_token.roles. Shipped baseline: csrf_token.roles=[], redirect_back=false, pseudo field hidden. Site has product type 'default' and variation type 'default'.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce I want an 'Add to cart' link (not a form) on my product catalog/teaser view mode using the commerce_add_to_cart_link module. What is the name of the field I enable, and where do I enable it?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'add_to_cart_link' pseudo/extra field on the product (or product variation) view mode via Manage display (drag it out of Disabled). It is provided by hook_entity_extra_field_info() on every commerce_product and commerce_product_variation bundle and is hidden by default; on the product it links the default variation, on a variation it links that variation.

evals.prompt: How does the commerce_add_to_cart_link module let me stop bots from guessing the add-to-cart URLs, and which config controls it?
evals.expected_output: You enable per-role CSRF token protection at Configuration -> Commerce -> Commerce Add To Cart Link, which writes commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings:csrf_token.roles. For users in those roles the commerce_add_to_cart_link.token service adds an HMAC token (private key + hash salt over the product/variation ids) to the link, and the controller's access() validates it. Empty roles = no protection.

evals.prompt: What are the two settings offered by the commerce_add_to_cart_link admin settings form, and what config object stores them?
evals.expected_output: The commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings config object stores csrf_token.roles (a list of role ids whose links get a CSRF token) and redirect_back (a boolean; when true the shopper returns to the referring page after adding, otherwise to the cart page). The form is at /admin/commerce/config/add-to-cart-link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live commerce_add_to_cart_link configuration and tell me which user role(s) currently have their add-to-cart links protected with a CSRF token, and whether redirect-back is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The 'authenticated' role is protected (commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings:csrf_token.roles = ['authenticated']) and redirect_back is true.

evals.prompt: On this site the commerce_add_to_cart_link 'add_to_cart_link' pseudo field is currently enabled on exactly one Commerce view display. Inspect the live view-display configuration and tell me which entity/view display shows it.
evals.expected_output: It is shown on the product variation default view display: commerce_product_variation.default.default has the add_to_cart_link component in the content region (getComponent('add_to_cart_link') is set, not hidden).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using commerce_add_to_cart_link, make the 'Add to cart' link appear on the default product view display (commerce_product.default.default) for the 'default' product type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the add_to_cart_link component to the commerce_product.default.default entity_view_display in a visible region, e.g. $display->setComponent('add_to_cart_link', ['weight' => 10, 'region' => 'content'])->save(); (or drag it out of Disabled on Manage display). getComponent('add_to_cart_link') must then be set (not hidden).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure commerce_add_to_cart_link so that add-to-cart links for users in the 'authenticated' role are protected with a CSRF token. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings:csrf_token.roles to include 'authenticated' (via the settings form or drush cset commerce_add_to_cart_link.settings csrf_token.roles.0 authenticated). The token service then adds an HMAC token to those users' links.
